title: BigBear.ai vs. Nebius: Which AI Stock Is the Better Buy for 2027?
author: John Ballard
description: The article compares two AI stocks: BigBear.ai, which provides defense-focused decision-intelligence software but faces declining revenue and significant losses, versus Nebius, a cloud infrastructure company experiencing explosive 444% revenue growth and recent profitability. title: CoreWeave's 15% Bond Yield Is a Warning for AI Debt. Here Are the Stocks Most Exposed.
author: Leo Sun
description: CoreWeave, a rapidly growing AI infrastructure provider, is raising red flags with its 15% bond yields and high leverage (debt-to-equity ratio of 14.3), despite strong revenue growth. The company spends a quarter of its revenue on interest payments and faces potential refinancing challenges if rates continue rising. While competitors like Nebius and IREN have lower leverage, CoreWeave's financial stress could impact the broader neocloud sector's ability to secure affordable financing.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite rapid revenue growth, CoreWeave faces severe financial stress with a 14.3 debt-to-equity ratio, 15% bond yields, and widening net losses. The company spends 25% of revenue on interest payments and faces refinancing challenges if rates rise further, creating significant solvency concerns by the early 2030s.

title: Is Nebius Stock a Buy After Its 36% Pullback?
author: Justin Pope
description: Nebius Group, an AI cloud company, has fallen 36% from its September highs amid concerns about funding for AI infrastructure.
